title: Fineract Back-Office UI deployment configuration
description: The deployment-owned overlay, mounted at branding/config.json. Every key is optional; whatever is present is merged over the values the image ships with. Upstream never writes this file.

defaultTenant.description: Tenant used when the user has not chosen one.

rbacEnabled.description: When false, the sidebar shows every entry and the permission directives render everything. A UI-visibility control only — authorization is always enforced server-side by Fineract.

institutionType.description: Which group-lending features this institution exposes.

developerToolsEnabled.description: Exposes screens driving Fineract's /v1/internal/** endpoints, which are served only under the backend's `test` Spring profile. Leave off anywhere real.

allowedApiOrigins.description: Absolute API origins this deployment permits beyond its own. Whatever is named here receives the user's credentials, so keep the list short.

branding.description: How this deployment looks. All asset paths are same-origin: the deployed CSP is img-src 'self' data:, so an off-origin logo would not render. Mount files beside this one.

appName.description: Product name in the header and the browser title. Plain text, not a translation key.

logoDarkUrl.description: Header logo for dark mode. Falls back to logoUrl.

tokens.description: Design-token overrides, applied as CSS custom properties. Only the names below are honoured; anything else is reported at startup and ignored.

dark.description: Applied under [data-theme='dark']. Names omitted here inherit the light value.

nav.description: Navigation adjustments. Everything here is keyed on an entry's stable id — never its label or route, both of which upstream changes freely.

hidden.description: Ids to hide, group headers included. Hiding a group hides its children. Presentational only: the route stays reachable by URL and authorization remains server-side.

icon.description: Replacement ionicon name. Must be one the application registers.

parent.description: Id of the group to move this entry into, or null for the top level.

items.description: Entries this deployment adds. Use a vendor prefix so ids cannot collide with upstream's.

assetPath.description: A same-origin, relative path. Absolute URLs are rejected.

primary-color.description: Accent and fill. Any colour is accepted: Ionic's label colour is derived from it, so a pale accent gets dark text. Useful for a lighter accent in dark mode.

secondary-color.description: Sidebar ground. Must clear 4.5:1 against white specifically: the sidebar pairs it with a literal white in CSS, so there is no label variable to flip.

id.description: Unique, and must not collide with an upstream id. Prefix it: "acme.crm".

parent.description: Id of the group to nest under.

kind.description: 'external' opens url in a new tab. Embedding in a frame is not supported: it would require widening the deployed CSP.

requiredPermissions.description: Fineract permission code(s) needed to see this entry. Gated exactly as upstream entries are.

requiredAllPermissions.description: Require all of requiredPermissions rather than any.
